parts.rubric: Questions 7 – 12. Choose the word to match the picture. Write the correct letter, A – G.

parts.label: Part 3
parts.name: Vocabulary — Life events
parts.rubric: Questions 13 – 18. Look at the pictures of life events. What are the missing letters? Some letters are already there. There is one space for each other letter in the word. Gõ trọn vẹn cụm từ vào ô trả lời.

parts.label: Part 4
parts.name: Reading — Sally’s email
parts.rubric: Questions 19 – 24. Read the email from Sally to a friend. Choose the best answer, A, B or C, for each space.

passage.title: From: Sally · To: Philip · Working in a hotel
passage.html:
Dear Philip

How are you? Did you finish university last month and are you looking for a job now? Well, why don’t you come and work with (19) …… at the hotel? I love working there! I think there’s a job in the kitchen, but it’s not a good job for you because you (20) …… cook very well. Sorry, but it’s true! Do you want to be a receptionist? That’s my job. It’s really interesting. I speak three languages so I (21) …… talk to people from different countries. What about you? (22) …… any other languages?

I work with some very friendly people. Do you want to come to the hotel tomorrow night and meet (23) ……? We usually all go out for a meal together – would you like to come with (24) ……? We always have a lot of fun!

See you tomorrow at about 6 o’clock?

Love, Sally
